items.name: Feta Saganaki Salad
items.desc: Our Warm Napa Cabbage Salad features crispy pepper bacon, mushrooms, and tangy blue cheese gorgonzola, all tossed in a flavorful red wine dressing. A savory and satisfying choice for any salad lover.

items.name: Caesar Salad
items.desc: Pistachio, goat cheese mousse, butter lettuce, tomatoes, roasted beets and raspberry dressing.

items.name: Kids Pasta
items.desc: Our Kids Pasta Butter is a delicious and simple dish perfect for young appetites. Made with tender pasta and a creamy butter sauce, it's a classic comfort food kids will love.

items.name: Tiramisu
items.desc: Taste our creamy and decadent Tiramisu, made with layers of espresso-soaked ladyfingers, mascarpone cheese, and cocoa powder. A classic Italian dessert that will leave you craving more.

items.name: New York Cheesecake
items.desc: Indulge in our rich and creamy New York Cheesecake, made with a buttery graham cracker crust and topped with a luscious layer of sweet, tangy cream cheese filling. A classic dessert favorite!

items.name: Sticky Toffee Pudding
items.desc: Indulge in our decadent Sticky Toffee Pudding, a warm and rich dessert made with dates and drizzled in a luscious toffee sauce. Perfect for satisfying your sweet tooth cravings.

items.name: Chocolate Lava Cake
items.desc: Indulge in our decadent Chocolate Lava Cake, a rich and moist chocolate cake with a gooey molten center. Served warm with a scoop of vanilla ice cream for the ultimate sweet treat.

items.name: Gelatos and Sorbet
items.desc: Indulge in our creamy Gelato and refreshing Sorbet, made with the finest ingredients and traditional techniques. Choose from a variety of flavors to satisfy your sweet cravings.

items.name: Affogato
items.desc: A classic Italian treat with our Affogato - a scoop of rich, creamy gelato topped with a shot of hot espresso, creating a decadent dessert and coffee combination.
